name: Party Data Return Criteria 2
definition: Return criteria for information to be returned in the report deriving from a query about party reference data.

OpeningDate.name: Opening Date
OpeningDate.definition: Indicates whether the opening date of the party is requested.

ClosingDate.name: Closing Date
ClosingDate.definition: Indicates whether the closing date of the party is requested.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Indicates whether the type is requested.

PartyIdentification.name: Party Identification
PartyIdentification.definition: Indicates whether the unique identification to unambiguously identify the party within the system is requested.

ResponsiblePartyIdentification.name: Responsible Party Identification
ResponsiblePartyIdentification.definition: Indicates whether the responsible party who initially created the party reference data is requested.

RestrictionIdentification.name: Restriction Identification
RestrictionIdentification.definition: Indicates whether the identification of the restriction is requested.

RestrictedOnDate.name: Restricted On Date
RestrictedOnDate.definition: Indicates whether the date at which a restriction for party has been issued is requested.

Name.name: Name
Name.definition: Indicates whether the name for the party is requested.

ShortName.name: Short Name
ShortName.definition: Indicates whether the short name for the party is requested.

Address.name: Address
Address.definition: Indicates whether the address for the party is requested.

TechnicalAddress.name: Technical Address
TechnicalAddress.definition: Indicates whether the technical addresses for the party are requested.

ContactDetails.name: Contact Details
ContactDetails.definition: Indicates whether the party contact details are requested.

ResidenceType.name: Residence Type
ResidenceType.definition: Indicates whether the residence type is requested.

LockStatus.name: Lock Status
LockStatus.definition: Indicates whether the lock status is requested.

MarketSpecificAttribute.name: Market Specific Attribute
MarketSpecificAttribute.definition: Indicates whether the market specific attributes for the party are requested.
